recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-5235 grammar rule for current active source without changing FHIR semantics; no work group review is needed unless editors want a broader style-only pass over valid contractions.
issue_request: FHIR-5235 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I DSTU1 technical correction resolved Persuasive with Modification. The ballot comment requested changing possessive uses of "it's" to "its", with the recorded resolution noting svn 4194 corrections on the extensibility page and additional core pages.
initial_application: Git-svn commit b96ed091e1a76a841b2ad40c8f31486489d18881 explicitly applied #5235 in svn @4194 across the historical extensibility, formats, HTTP, narrative, profiling, search, terminologies, terminology-service, references, overview, summary, NDF-RT, and resource notes pages. A later 2015 commit, 2558ea5d0fcbefcf5a96d997dfb6703213200e2b, made another possessive "it's" cleanup, confirming the intended convention.
additional_context: A bounded current-source scan found no missed possessive instances in the original FHIR-5235 page set, but found same-class possessive typos in active current sources. Build-scope checks tied the edited datatype pages to fhir.ini type-pages, the resource notes and introductions to active fhir.ini resources, the ValueSet request example to the active $expand operation definition, and license.html to the published index page. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion that changed the Jira/history/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed only the identified possessive typo instances from "it's" to "its" in source/elementdefinition.html, source/dosage.html, source/invoice/invoice-introduction.xml, source/insuranceplan/insuranceplan-introduction.xml, source/insuranceproduct/insuranceproduct-introduction.xml, source/license.html, source/valueset/$expand-request.txt, source/capabilitystatement/capabilitystatement-notes.xml, source/references.html, and source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml. Legitimate "it is" contractions were left unchanged.
